select mr.id AS medicalRecordId, p.real_name AS patientName, p.phone AS patientPhone, CASE WHEN p.gender = 1 THEN '男' WHEN p.gender = 2 THEN '女' ELSE '未知' END AS patientGender, CASE WHEN p.id_card IS NULL OR p.id_card = '' THEN NULL WHEN LENGTH(p.id_card) = 18 THEN YEAR(CURDATE()) - CAST(SUBSTRING(p.id_card, 7, 4) AS UNSIGNED) WHEN LENGTH(p.id_card) = 15 THEN YEAR(CURDATE()) - CAST(CONCAT('19', SUBSTRING(p.id_card, 7, 2)) AS UNSIGNED) ELSE NULL END AS patientAge, d.real_name AS doctorName, mr.doctor_description AS doctorDescription, mr.is_purchasable AS isPurchasable, mr.create_time AS createTime
from medical_record mr INNER JOIN patient_attendant p ON p.id = mr.patient_id INNER JOIN doctor_detail d ON mr.doctor_id = d.id
where mr.doctor_id = #{doctorId} and mr.is_deleted = 0 and p.is_deleted = 0 and d.is_deleted=0
and p.real_name like #{medicalRecordCondition.patientName}
and DATE(mr.create_time) = DATE(#{medicalRecordCondition.createTime})
and mr.is_purchasable = #{medicalRecordCondition.prescriptionStatus}
order by mr.create_time ASC

select pr.*, mr.doctor_description AS doctorDescription, mr.is_purchasable AS isPurchasable, mr.create_time AS createTime, d.generic_name AS drugName, d.minimum_sales_unit AS minimumSalesUnit, d.drug_price AS price, case when d.is_prescription = 1 then '处方药' else '非处方药' end AS isPrescription from prescription pr INNER JOIN medical_record mr ON pr.medical_record_id = mr.id INNER JOIN drug d ON pr.drug_id = d.id where pr.medical_record_id = #{medicalRecordId} and pr.is_deleted = 0 and d.is_deleted = 0 and mr.is_deleted =0 order by pr.create_time ASC
